result.markdown: --- title: "Estimated Marginal Means with `R`" author: - name: "[Ajinkya Kokandakar](https://ajinkya-k.github.io)" email: ajinkya@stat.wisc.edu orcid: 0000-0001-6628-2272 affiliations: - name: 'ajinkya-k.github.io' city: Madison state: WI url: https://ajinkya-k.github.io department: Statistics date: "2025-01-24" format: revealjs: slide-number: true smaller: true progress: true css: "../styles.scss" code-line-numbers: false highlight-style: atom-one theme: - ../styles.scss --- ## Overview - What `emmeans` does and doesn't do? - Visualizing interaction - Analyzing interactions - Marginal means vs pairwise comparisons - Multiplicity corrections ## Marginal Means If you have a model of the form: ```r response ~ treatment * variety ``` the following are "marginal means": - average response value in treatment `T`(or `N`) - average response value for variety `A`(or `B` or `C`) `emmeans` just computes these means, and any contrasts between them ## Example ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nt <- 2 # number of treatments nv <- 3 # number of varieties mc <- 4 # number of observations per cell n <- nt * nv * mc # total number of observations dt <- data.frame( treatment = factor(rep(c("T", "N"), each = nv * mc), levels = c("N", "T")), variety = factor(rep(LETTERS[1:nv], nt * mc), levels = LETTERS[1:nv]) ) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ::: Generate the mean (hidden) and then draw the responses ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} dt$response <- rnorm(n, mean = dt$mean) ``` ::: **Looking at cross-tabs** ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` treatment variety N T Sum A 4 4 8 B 4 4 8 C 4 4 8 Sum 12 12 24 ``` ::: ::: ## Visualize ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} library(ggplot2) library(khroma) library(gridExtra) library(colorout) library(lme4) theme_set(theme_minimal()) theme_update(legend.position = "bottom") options(ggplot2.discrete.colour = c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833", "#CCBB44", "#66CCEE", "#AA3377", "#BBBBBB")) options(ggplot2.discrete.fill = color("bright")(7)) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} par(mfrow = c(1,2)) boxplot(response ~ treatment, dt, col = khroma::color("nightfall")(2)) boxplot(response ~ variety, dt, col = khroma::color("sunset")(3)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](emmeans_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## Model ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} lmod <- lm(response ~ treatment * variety, dt) anova(lmod) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Analysis of Variance Table Response: response Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F) treatment 1 90.160 90.160 120.219 2.127e-09 *** variety 2 28.822 14.411 19.215 3.418e-05 *** treatment:variety 2 0.360 0.180 0.240 0.7891 Residuals 18 13.499 0.750 --- Signif. codes: 0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1 ``` ::: ::: ## Model: with random effects ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} lmm_sim <- lmer(response ~ treatment + (1 | variety), dt) summary(lmm_sim) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Linear mixed model fit by REML ['lmerMod'] Formula: response ~ treatment + (1 | variety) Data: dt REML criterion at convergence: 65.4 Scaled residuals: Min 1Q Median 3Q Max -1.94902 -0.56378 0.00866 0.49068 1.88314 Random effects: Groups Name Variance Std.Dev. variety (Intercept) 1.715 1.3095 Residual 0.693 0.8324 Number of obs: 24, groups: variety, 3 Fixed effects: Estimate Std. Error t value (Intercept) 7.6950 0.7933 9.70 treatmentT 3.8764 0.3398 11.41 Correlation of Fixed Effects: (Intr) treatmentT -0.214 ``` ::: ::: ## Interaction Plot ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(emmeans) p1 <- emmip(lmod, variety ~ treatment) p2 <- emmip(lmod, treatment ~ variety) grid.arrange(p1, p2, nrow = 1) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](emmeans_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## Revealing the model ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} m_glob <- 10 dt$mean <- with( dt, m_glob + ifelse(treatment == "N", -2, 2) + (as.numeric(variety) - 2) * 1.5 ) ``` ::: ## Adding interactions ::: {.cell} ::: ## Model again ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} lmint <- lm(respint ~ treatment * variety, dt) summary(lmint) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Call: lm(formula = respint ~ treatment * variety, data = dt) Residuals: Min 1Q Median 3Q Max -1.6911 -0.7912 -0.1502 0.8256 2.0373 Coefficients: Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|) (Intercept) 6.4510 0.6313 10.218 6.40e-09 *** treatmentT 10.2039 0.8928 11.429 1.10e-09 *** varietyB 1.8192 0.8928 2.038 0.056561 . varietyC 3.5529 0.8928 3.979 0.000879 *** treatmentT:varietyB -6.9402 1.2626 -5.497 3.21e-05 *** treatmentT:varietyC -13.3385 1.2626 -10.564 3.81e-09 *** --- Signif. codes: 0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1 Residual standard error: 1.263 on 18 degrees of freedom Multiple R-squared: 0.9094, Adjusted R-squared: 0.8842 F-statistic: 36.14 on 5 and 18 DF, p-value: 8.919e-09 ``` ::: ::: ## Interaction Effect ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](emmeans_files/figure-revealjs/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=960} ::: ::: ## `emmeans` does not model the data - `emmeans` computes them _given_ a model - you need a model before using it!

<script>
  // htmlwidgets need to know to resize themselves when slides are shown/hidden.
  // Fire the "slideenter" event (handled by htmlwidgets.js) when the current
  // slide changes (different for each slide format).
  (function () {
    // dispatch for htmlwidgets
    function fireSlideEnter() {
      const event = window.document.createEvent("Event");
      event.initEvent("slideenter", true, true);
      window.document.dispatchEvent(event);
    }

    function fireSlideChanged(previousSlide, currentSlide) {
      fireSlideEnter();

      // dispatch for shiny
      if (window.jQuery) {
        if (previousSlide) {
          window.jQuery(previousSlide).trigger("hidden");
        }
        if (currentSlide) {
          window.jQuery(currentSlide).trigger("shown");
        }
      }
    }

    // hookup for slidy
    if (window.w3c_slidy) {
      window.w3c_slidy.add_observer(function (slide_num) {
        // slide_num starts at position 1
        fireSlideChanged(null, w3c_slidy.slides[slide_num - 1]);
      });
    }

  })();
</script>
